ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the entities involved, the amount of money stolen, and the impact on Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program.
questions: What were the key players involved in the scheme?
What was the impact on Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme is a complex case involving multiple entities and a large amount of money. A deeper dive into the scheme could reveal more about the vulnerabilities of Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program.

ideas.title: The Taco Bell Lettuce Supplier Investigation: What Went Wrong?
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Taco Bell lettuce supplier investigation, including the causes of the cyclospora illness outbreak and the response of the supplier and regulatory agencies.
questions: What caused the cyclospora illness outbreak?
How did the supplier respond to the outbreak?
What actions were taken by regulatory agencies?
ideas.insight: The Taco Bell lettuce supplier investigation highlights the importance of food safety and the need for effective regulation and oversight.
